dedupe_keys.name: weis floating wind turbine co design suite

description: WEIS, Wind Energy with Integrated Servo-control, is the National Laboratory of the Rockies' suite for designing floating offshore wind turbines across several model fidelities. It connects WISDEM, OpenFAST, TurbSim, ROSCO and RAFT with optimisation and output-processing tools. YAML definitions specify turbine designs and analysis choices; outputs support comparisons of performance, loads and cost-related design objectives. Spatial coverage is the selected turbine or design problem, while time resolution follows the coupled model and wind conditions. Apache-2.0 source is free, with environment instructions for Linux, macOS and Windows. A limitation is the substantial dependency stack, including compiled models and optional parallel libraries; successful installation was not tested. WEIS supports coupled design and capacity-planning simulations for offshore energy infrastructure. The first review separately drafted WISDEM and OpenFAST. WEC-Sim (platform-wec-sim) offers related offshore-energy modelling. No model archive or installer was downloaded.
